data.translation: Uncle Isho: They used to take it from all the people; no one remained from whom it did not take. Yusuf the Siirt man, the house of Saliba of the house of Ahoke, Isa of the house of Awrohim, you people, the house of Sawo‘e, the house of Maqsi Musa, the house of Shakkire, all, all. Each one, each one, they used to impose it on them: some two thousand, some four thousand, some six thousand, some eight thousand. And very, very many, ten thousand. Every Christian man who had ‘Warləq’ [wealth], whom they knew about, they imposed it on him. And they notified them: ‘From now until a month from now, if you do not pay it, you will be put in prison!’ At that time, the one who did not pay, they would either exile him or put him in prison, until he paid his money.
